cc:Work.dc:description: Each point: own-objective mean of logged minibatches in a nonoverlapping 2,000-step bin; black: equal mean across 3 seeds. Each logged loss is one 2,040-target minibatch, computed before its optimizer update; curves contain no intermediate held-out metrics. Panels use separate y-scales. Cross-entropy and Brier objective magnitudes/slopes are not comparable as learning speeds. Shading marks the late windows selected for this analysis; statistics use unsmoothed logged losses. Saved records only; no new runs.
